name: Toa Tomohito
source:
"[i]I'll say it as many times as needed, okay? If something's troubling you, tell me, Taiga. Don't hold back. And don't push yourself too hard either.[/i]"

He’s the protagonist’s [b]best friend[/b].

He has an easygoing personality and is kind to everyone.
But when things get serious, he's someone you can rely on.
He loves music, and his dream is to make it in music.

He’s also good-looking, extremely popular with girls,
and completely and utterly oblivious to it.

He always has his pockets stuffed full of snacks,
and whenever the gluttonous Hiori begs him for some,
he just hands them over and lets her eat.
He is terribly lazy and is always thinking of ways to skip school.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 181cm
[i]Favorite food[/i]: None in particular.
[i]Blood type[/i]: B

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]

[spoiler]He is the father of the real Kanade Taiga (not the nameless protagonist).[/spoiler]
